data.description: Add 1 to the DCs of your spells and abilities that have the curse descriptor (Pathfinder RPG Ultimate Magic 137). Once per day as a standard action, you can use baleful polymorph as a spell-like ability, with a caster level equal to your character level. This counts as a curse, and the DC of any caster level check to remove it increases by 5.
